subproblem.title: Integration by parts of the annular monotonicity identity against an absolutely continuous factor (parent Step 2)
subproblem.statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Borel σ-algebra) that is finite on compact sets, ξ ∈ E, w: E → ℝ with w(x) ≥ 0 for all x, a, e, F, F': ℝ → ℝ, and 0 < σ ≤ ρ. Write B_t for the closed ball of radius t about ξ and A := B_ρ∖B_σ. Assume: w is μ-integrable on A; e is Lebesgue integrable on (σ, ρ]; a(t) − a(s) = ∫_{B_t∖B_s} w dμ + ∫_{(s,t]} e(τ)dτ for all σ ≤ s ≤ t ≤ ρ; F' is integrable on (σ, ρ]; and F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]} F'(τ)dτ for every t ∈ [σ, ρ]. Then x ↦ F(|x−ξ|)w(x) is μ-integrable on A, and F(ρ)a(ρ) − F(σ)a(σ) = ∫_A F(|x−ξ|)w(x)dμ(x) + ∫_{(σ,ρ]} (F(τ)e(τ) + F'(τ)a(τ))dτ.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (w : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (a e F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (σ ρ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) → IntegrableOn w (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ → IntegrableOn e (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ s t : ℝ, σ ≤ s → s ≤ t → t ≤ ρ → a t - a s = ∫ x in closedBall ξ t \ closedBall ξ s, w x ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc s t, e τ) → IntegrableOn F' (Ioc σ ρ) → (∀ t ∈ Icc σ ρ, F t = F σ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, F' τ) → IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ F ‖x - ξ‖ * w x) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ F ρ * a ρ - F σ * a σ = ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, F ‖x - ξ‖ * w x ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (F τ * e τ + F' τ * a τ)
subproblem.natural_proof:
0. Notation. r(x) := |x−ξ| = dist(x, ξ), so B_t = {x : r(x) ≤ t}. For σ ≤ t ≤ ρ we have B_ρ∖B_t = {x ∈ A : t < r(x)} (if r(x) > t ≥ σ then x ∉ B_σ); in particular A = {x : σ < r(x) ≤ ρ}. μ(A) ≤ μ(B_ρ) < ∞ because B_ρ is compact, so μ⌞A is a finite measure; λ denotes Lebesgue measure and all integrals over (s, t] are λ-integrals. Put W := ∫_A w dμ ∈ [0, ∞) and ‖e‖ := ∫_{(σ,ρ]}|e|.
1. For t ∈ [σ, ρ] let D(t) := ∫_{B_ρ∖B_t} w dμ and P(t) := ∫_{(t,ρ]} e. Since w ≥ 0 is integrable on A and B_ρ∖B_t ⊆ A decreases as t increases, D is nonincreasing on [σ, ρ] with 0 ≤ D ≤ W = D(σ). P is continuous on [σ, ρ] (absolute continuity of the integral) and |P| ≤ ‖e‖.
2. The hypothesis with (s, t) := (t, ρ) gives a(t) = a(ρ) − D(t) − P(t) for every t ∈ [σ, ρ]. Hence on [σ, ρ], a is Borel measurable (a constant plus a monotone function plus a continuous function) and bounded: |a| ≤ M_a := |a(ρ)| + W + ‖e‖.
3. From F(t) = F(σ) + ∫_{(σ,t]}F' on [σ, ρ], F is continuous on [σ, ρ] (indefinite integral of an integrable function), hence bounded there: |F| ≤ M_F := |F(σ)| + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}|F'|.
4. Integrability. (a) r maps A continuously into (σ, ρ] ⊆ [σ, ρ], and F is continuous on [σ, ρ]; so F∘r is continuous on the Borel set A, hence μ⌞A-measurable, and |F(r(x))w(x)| ≤ M_F w(x). Thus F(r)w is μ-integrable on A, which is the first assertion. (b) F·e, F'·a, F'·D and F'·P are integrable on (σ, ρ]: each is the product of an integrable function (e or F') with a function that is bounded and measurable on [σ, ρ] (by 1–3).
5. Write F(ρ)a(ρ) − F(σ)a(σ) = F(σ)(a(ρ) − a(σ)) + (F(ρ) − F(σ))a(ρ).
6. The hypothesis with (s, t) := (σ, ρ) gives F(σ)(a(ρ) − a(σ)) = F(σ)W + F(σ)∫_{(σ,ρ]}e.
7. The hypothesis on F at t = ρ and step 2 (a(ρ) = a(t) + D(t) + P(t) for t ∈ (σ, ρ]) give (F(ρ) − F(σ))a(ρ) = ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'(t)a(ρ)dt = ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'a + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'D + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'P, all three integrable by 4(b).
8. Fubini on the annulus. Let Φ(t, x) := F'(t)w(x)1{t < r(x)} on (σ, ρ] × A with the finite product measure λ⌞(σ,ρ] ⊗ μ⌞A. Φ is measurable (F' and w are a.e.-strongly measurable and {(t, x) : t < r(x)} is open) and ∫∫|Φ| ≤ (∫_{(σ,ρ]}|F'|)·W < ∞, so Fubini's theorem applies. For fixed t ∈ (σ, ρ], ∫_A w(x)1{t < r(x)}dμ(x) = ∫_{B_ρ∖B_t} w dμ = D(t) by 0. For fixed x ∈ A, {t ∈ (σ, ρ] : t < r(x)} = (σ, r(x)), which differs from (σ, r(x)] by one point, so ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'(t)1{t < r(x)}dt = ∫_{(σ,r(x)]}F' = F(r(x)) − F(σ) by the hypothesis on F at t = r(x) ∈ (σ, ρ]. Therefore ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'(t)D(t)dt = ∫_A w(x)(F(r(x)) − F(σ))dμ(x) = ∫_A F(r)w dμ − F(σ)W.
9. Fubini on the triangle. Let Ψ(t, s) := F'(t)e(s)1{t < s} on (σ, ρ]² with λ ⊗ λ; Ψ is measurable and ∫∫|Ψ| ≤ (∫|F'|)·‖e‖ < ∞. For fixed t, ∫_{(σ,ρ]}e(s)1{t < s}ds = P(t); for fixed s ∈ (σ, ρ], ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'(t)1{t < s}dt = ∫_{(σ,s)}F' = ∫_{(σ,s]}F' = F(s) − F(σ). By Fubini, ∫_{(σ,ρ]}F'(t)P(t)dt = ∫_{(σ,ρ]}e(s)(F(s) − F(σ))ds = ∫_{(σ,ρ]}Fe − F(σ)∫_{(σ,ρ]}e.
10. Adding 6, 7, 8, 9 (linearity is justified by 4): F(ρ)a(ρ) − F(σ)a(σ) = F(σ)W + F(σ)∫e + ∫F'a + (∫_A F(r)w dμ − F(σ)W) + (∫Fe − F(σ)∫e) = ∫_A F(|x−ξ|)w(x)dμ(x) + ∫_{(σ,ρ]}(F(τ)e(τ) + F'(τ)a(τ))dτ, since the terms containing F(σ) cancel. ∎
proof_key_steps: Annulus description B_ρ∖B_t = {x ∈ A : t < |x−ξ|} for t ∈ [σ, ρ]; μ⌞A is finite
a = a(ρ) − D − P on [σ, ρ] with D monotone and P continuous, so a is bounded Borel; F is continuous hence bounded on [σ, ρ]
Integrability of F(|x−ξ|)w on A and of Fe, F'a, F'D, F'P on (σ, ρ]
F(ρ)a(ρ) − F(σ)a(σ) = F(σ)(a(ρ) − a(σ)) + ∫F'(t)[a(t) + D(t) + P(t)]dt
Fubini on (σ, ρ] × A: ∫F'D = ∫_A w(F(|x−ξ|) − F(σ))dμ
Fubini on the triangle σ < t < s ≤ ρ: ∫F'P = ∫e(F − F(σ))

audit.reason: The prose and type contain all required assumptions. The proof derives bounded measurability of a and continuity of F, establishes product integrability, and justifies both Fubini exchanges. Removing a singleton only in the Lebesgue variable correctly preserves the closed-ball annular boundary.
